## Workflow 00G — Durable Intake Gateway — DRAFT
Inactive; retention_enabled=false and handoff_enabled=false. Manual run is offline. No messages, new bot webhook or paid calls are added.

Deploy the reviewed opt-in intake API to the existing worker with a persistent local volume and INTAKE_TOKEN. Bind that token using HTTP Header Auth on all HTTP nodes: Authorization = Bearer <INTAKE_TOKEN>. No secret belongs in Code nodes.

Set base_url, then enable retention to test a topic and actual source file. Confirm checksums and selected slide/page references. Only enable handoff after a compatible intelligence sub-workflow is configured in the server-side binding file.

The gateway does not enable old project/voice/final workflows without verified adapters. Unknown downstream outcomes require reconciliation; do not blindly rerun paid work. The downstream must implement intake-handoff.v1 deduplication and return intake-receipt.v1. Read quality/INTAKE_GATEWAY_SETUP.md.

Bind this imported workflow ID in Workflow 00 only after testing. Keep one Telegram ingress.
